mapper.sql: follow_id, customer_id, employee_id, follow_type, follow_time, next_follow_time, content, stage, probability, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM customer_follow WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY follow_time DESC

SELECT c.customer_id as customerId, c.customer_name as customerName, c.customer_type as customerType, c.customer_status as customerStatus, c.owner_employee_id as ownerEmployeeId, MAX(f.follow_time) as lastFollowTime, MIN(f.next_follow_time) as nextFollowTime, COUNT(f.follow_id) as followCount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN customer_follow f ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
AND c.owner_employee_id = #{params.employeeId}
AND (f.next_follow_time IS NULL OR f.next_follow_time <= NOW())
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, c.customer_status, c.owner_employee_id ORDER BY nextFollowTime ASC, lastFollowTime DESC
